name: Ocean God’s Blessing
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target of ocean god’s blessing receives a +10 bonus to Swim checks for the spell’s duration. The spell also doubles the amount of time the target can hold his breath (to 4 times the target’s Constitution score).
